scope: T15 first slice: no drawing on an unchanged separate HUD; full authoritative paint for changes, always paint fresh inline world pixels.

pixels.metric: SHA-256 of complete HUD getImageData RGBA bytes at each matched backing size; not a scene/GL readback

pacing.mode: software Canvas with CPU compositor (not device FPS)
pacing.world: same locked 0.75x Low Canvas and seed 42; 60 Hz deterministic simulation input, reported rAF gaps are real foreground callbacks
pacing.quiet: stationary player with live weather and scene submits; no FPS overlay
pacing.busy: travel with deterministic low HP, active Flow, boss, charge, prompt and banner inputs; not a combat throughput benchmark
pacing.counts: actual clearRect, fillText, fillRect/strokeRect calls on the separate HUD. Cleared pixels are submitted area, not measured memory traffic. JS HUD time measures drawHud submission, not raster completion or state sampling.

unchangedFailures: the blade cleaves a tight pack (26px), every sword strike
how deep the blade cuts does not depend on the frame rate
no joint is welded shut in any core strike
six extra authored keys in each sword ritual preserve timing and gate beats
a connecting strike puts the striking joint ON the body, not near it

notMeasured: physical device scan-out/frame rate or GPU compositor timing
actual memory traffic from the clear
